1: // Simple Space Debris Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   function playSound(freq, duration) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.type = 'square';
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   }
21: 
22:   // Set canvas size to match its displayed size
23:   function resize() {
24:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
25:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
26:     generateStars();
27:   }
28:   resize();
29:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
30: 
31:   // Ship properties
32:   const ship = {
33:     w: 30,
34:     h: 30,
35:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 15,
36:     y: canvas.height - 60,
37:     speed: 4,
38:     color: '#0f0',
39:   };
40: 
41:   // Debris array
42:   const debris = [];
43:   // Background stars for visual depth
44:   let stars = [];
45:   function generateStars(count = 100) {
46:     stars = [];
47:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
48:       stars.push({
49:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
50:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
51:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
52:       });
53:     }
54:   }
55:   let debrisTimer = 0;
56:   let debrisInterval = 1500; // ms, will decrease over time
57:   let lastTime = 0;
58:   let score = 0;
59:   let gameOver = false;
60: 
61:   const keys = {};
62:   let audioStarted = false;
63:   function startAudio(){
64:     if (!audioStarted){
65:       audioCtx.resume();
66:       audioStarted = true;
67:     }
68:   }
69:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; startAudio(); });
70:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
71: 
72:   function spawnDebris() {
73:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
74:     debris.push({
75:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
76:       y: -size,
77:       w: size,
78:       h: size,
79:       speed: Math.random() * 1.5 + 1 + score / 1000,
80:       color: '#f88',
81:     });
82:     // play short ping for new debris
83:     playSound(200, 0.05);
84:   }
85: 
86:   function update(dt) {
87:     // Move ship based on keys (arrow keys or WASD)
88:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.x -= ship.speed;
89:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.x += ship.speed;
90:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ship.y -= ship.speed;
91:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ship.y += ship.speed;
92:     // Keep ship inside canvas
93:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x));
94:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
95: 
96:     // Spawn debris based on timer
97:     debrisTimer += dt;
98:     if (debrisTimer > debrisInterval) {
99:       spawnDebris();
100:       debrisTimer = 0;
101:       // gradually increase difficulty
102:       if (debrisInterval > 400) debrisInterval -= 20;
103:     }
104: 
105:     // Update debris positions
106:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
107:       const d = debris[i];
108:       d.y += d.speed;
109:       // Remove off-screen debris
110:       if (d.y > canvas.height) {
111:         debris.splice(i, 1);
112:         score += 1;
113:       } else if (rectIntersect(ship, d)) {
114:         gameOver = true;
115:       }
116:     }
117:   }
118: 
119:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
120:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
121:   }
122: 
123:   function draw() {
124:     // Draw background gradient
125:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
126:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
127:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
128:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
129:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
130: 
131:     // Draw stars
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
133:     stars.forEach(s => {
134:       ctx.beginPath();
135:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:       ctx.fill();
137:     });
138: 
139:     // Draw ship as triangle
140:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
141:     ctx.beginPath();
142:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
143:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
144:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
145:     ctx.closePath();
146:     ctx.fill();
147: 
148:     // Draw debris as rotating squares with gradient fill
149:     debris.forEach(d => {
150:       const rot = (performance.now() / 200) % (Math.PI * 2);
151:       ctx.save();
152:       ctx.translate(d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2);
153:       ctx.rotate(rot);
154:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, d.w * 0.2, 0, 0, d.w / 2);
155:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f44');
156:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
157:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
158:       ctx.fillRect(-d.w / 2, -d.h / 2, d.w, d.h);
159:       ctx.restore();
160:     });
161: 
162:     // Draw score
163:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
164:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
165:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
166:     if (gameOver) {
167:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
168:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
169:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
170:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
171:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
172:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
173:       ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
174:     }
175:   }
176: 
177:   function loop(timestamp) {
178:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
179:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
180:     lastTime = timestamp;
181:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
182:     draw();
183:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
184:   }
185: 
186:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
187: })();

(End of file - total 187 lines)
